policy.primary: mean final-team-wins CRPS across all16 origins; each season/origin/team equal
policy.development: First12 origins/seasons ending2023-25; leave-one-season-out selection within these three only.
policy.independent: All four2025-26 origins withheld until unchanged nominee selected on development. Other candidates cannot replace a failed nominee.
policy.nominee: Minimum development mean CRPS among candidates with mean gain>=.05 and no date mean CRPS harm>.10; deterministic lexical ties. No development survivor means retain v1.
policy.uncertainty: 10000 paired complete-season block resamples, seed20261124; retain all four dates and30 teams in each season block. Four seasons are sparse/dependent evidence, not independent960 team-starts.
policy.multiplicity: All16 inference uses simultaneous Bonferroni95% intervals for three frozen candidates (quantiles .0083333/.9916667). No switched primary.
policy.acceptance: Unchanged nominee: all16 mean CRPS gain>=.05 and familywise lower>0; independent2025-26 mean gain>0; no MM-DD mean CRPS harm>.10, no coverage80 shortfall increase>.03, dispersion-distance-to1 not worse by>.10. Report persistence and team-points CRPS/bias; no pooled cancellation hides dates.
policy.per_origin_uncertainty: Paired canonical1k-world chunk bootstrap describes Monte Carlo precision only; generalisation intervals use whole historical seasons. No team or world iid claim.
policy.promotion_limit: Only conditional regular-season calibration from reconstructed schedules; no historical title/postseason certification. Unknown schedule revision timestamps, neutral metadata and absent injury history remain explicit.
policy.release: No new production parameter until all16/source/accounting/cutoff/exact-mixture/runtime gates and B3 integration pass. Failure closes this fixed study, retains pathway-v1 and records unmet objectives.
